meta.name: Dance of the Dead
meta.description: On the night of Cosa High's prom, a cemetery next to a power plant unleashes an army of zombies. With their town overrun, an unlikely group of outcasts, geeks, cheerleaders, and bad boys must band together to survive, save their classmates, and stop the undead invasion.
meta.slogan: Prom. It's their night to come alive.
